title: Four Seasons Fun
audience: Chinese primary school students (10-12 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A four-panel cartoon showing the same girl enjoying spring, summer, autumn and winter activities
imageDescription: A four-panel comic about the seasons, each panel showing the same black-haired girl. Top left, SPRING: a smiling sun, blue sky, green grass and colorful tulips; the girl in a pink sweater flies a rainbow kite, and the caption reads WARM! FLY A KITE. Top right, SUMMER: a red sun wearing sunglasses and a thermometer with high red mercury; the girl in a yellow swimsuit and goggles laughs in a swimming pool with a pink swim ring, palm trees behind her, caption HOT! GO SWIMMING. Bottom left, AUTUMN: an apple tree heavy with red apples and orange-red leaves floating down; the girl in an orange hoodie and cap picks apples into a basket, caption COOL! PICK APPLES. Bottom right, WINTER: snowy pine trees and a big snowflake; the girl in a red coat, red hat, pink scarf and mittens builds a smiling snowman with a carrot nose, caption COLD! MAKE A SNOWMAN.
scoringDescription: A bright cartoon four-panel comic, two panels on top and two below, separated by black borders, each labelled with a season title in black letters and a white caption strip at the bottom. Panel 1 (top left) SPRING: sky blue with small clouds, a yellow sun with a happy smiling face, green hills, pink, red, yellow and white flowers and tulips; the girl wears a pink sweater with a white flower and blue trousers, holding a kite string and a red spool; a rainbow-colored diamond kite with a bow tail flies at the top right; caption WARM! FLY A KITE. Panel 2 (top right) SUMMER: a red sun wearing black sunglasses, a thermometer at the right edge with the red bar filled to the top showing high temperature, palm trees and a pool ladder; the girl in a yellow polka-dot swimsuit with blue goggles on her head plays in a blue pool, water splashing, a pink-yellow swim ring around her; caption HOT! GO SWIMMING. Panel 3 (bottom left) AUTUMN: an apple tree with red apples, orange and red maple leaves falling and covering the ground, golden hills behind; the girl in an orange hoodie, orange cap and blue jeans reaches up to pick an apple while holding a wicker basket full of apples; caption COOL! PICK APPLES. Panel 4 (bottom right) WINTER: white snow ground, snow-covered pine trees, a large blue snowflake symbol in the sky; the girl in a red coat, red knit hat with snowflake pattern, pink striped scarf and red snowflake mittens puts a mitten on a smiling snowman with a carrot nose, red hat and red striped scarf; caption COLD! MAKE A SNOWMAN. The four weather words are warm, hot, cool, cold, matched to spring, summer, autumn, winter. The smiling spring sun versus the sunglasses-wearing summer sun shows summer is hotter. Activity-season matching: fly a kite - spring, go swimming - summer, pick apples - autumn, make a snowman - winter.
